name: Comment thread
summary: A nested list of comments with author, timestamp, actions (reply, like, resolve) and a composer. For async discussion attached to a document, task or issue.

anatomy.purpose: Ordered list of comment nodes; visually indents replies one level.
Avatar, author, timestamp, body and action row.
Reply, like and (in review tools) resolve. Buttons with visible labels or tooltips.
Textarea plus submit. Present at the top level and inline under any comment being replied to.
Marks the thread resolved; collapses it in review contexts.

contentLimits.depth: indent at most 2 levels, then flatten with @mentions

variants.name: Review (resolvable)
variants.use: Document or code review threads that can be resolved.

contentLimits.resolution: resolved threads collapse but remain readable

whenToUse: Async, threaded feedback tied to a specific artifact (document, design, issue, video timestamp).
Review workflows that need resolve/unresolve state.
Community discussion where replies form sub-threads.
whenNotToUse: Anonymous one-off reactions: use a rating or reaction bar.
Long-form publishing with full-page comments as content: use a dedicated page pattern.

accessibility.role: list for the thread; article per comment; textbox for the composer
keyboard: Tab moves through comment actions and the composer in DOM order.
Reply opens the inline composer and moves focus into it.
Escape closes an inline composer and returns focus to the Reply button.
Resolve toggle is a button with aria-pressed reflecting state.
accessibility.focus: Visible focus on every action button and the composer; after posting, focus moves to the new comment or stays in the composer per product convention — document the choice.
notes: Announce new comments with aria-live=polite on the thread region.
Author and timestamp must be programmatically associated with the comment body.
Indentation alone must not carry meaning; replies are nested in the list structure.
Like/resolve counts are text, not icon-only.
